areas: Upstream v0.1.8-nightly.20261104.4192..v0.1.8-nightly.20261105.4218: 37 commits over one nightly, merged as one commit whose parents are the fork tip and the upstream tag.

Four conflicted files: the client-runtime export map, the contracts RPC group (upstream's getThreadTitles), the ACP MCP-over-ACP bridge (upstream's TaggedError refactor) and pnpm-lock (claude-agent-sdk 0.3.316 against the fork catalog). Seventeen more files conflicted in hunks and are resolved in the same commit.

Structural changes: Effect error classes became Schema.TaggedError (#31216), Effect.try gained typed catches (#31217) and environment reads moved to HostProcess.Environment (#31218); the rules these enforce now fail fork-only files, 26 errors after the merge and none now.

Behaviour changes reaching fork code: an interrupted completion wake keeps its surviving siblings (#28204), usage-limit auto-resume is attributed to T3 Code (#29838), Lineage hides a deleted fork and names rows from the thread-title read (#29000), an idle agent tab nobody views gives up its browser slot (#24186), Claude MCP apps render tool output (#29803), and the cloud link store was renamed (#26464).
Every recorded entry is accounted for: twelve adapted, the rest retained as unchanged because nothing in this nightly reaches their integration points.

exclusions.why: Upstream reviewed its own commits; the review judges the reconciliation only, never upstream's diff.
